kpis.description_fr: Revenu net Medpace = honoraires services CRO Phase I-IV. Croissance FY25 +20% portée par Metabolic, Oncologie, SNC. 82% clients petites biotechs, 13% mid-cap, 5% big pharma.
kpis.description_en: Medpace net revenue = Phase I-IV CRO services fees. FY25 +20% growth driven by Metabolic, Oncology, CNS therapeutic areas. 82% small biotech clients, 13% mid-cap, 5% big pharma.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog = revenu net futur anticipé des contrats signés non terminés. KPI maître CRO (visibilité ~14 mois revenu). Fin FY25 : 3,03 Mds $, dont ~1,9 Mds attendus en revenu 2026.
kpis.description_en: Backlog = anticipated future net revenue from signed contracts not yet completed. Core CRO metric (~14 months revenue visibility). End FY25: $3.03B, ~$1.9B expected to convert to 2026 revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Effectifs Medpace fin d'exercice, répartis sur 46 pays. Capacité opérationnelle directe (CRO = business 100% labor). FY25 : 6200 (+300 net) après plateau FY23-24 (biotech funding winter).
kpis.description_en: Medpace end-of-year headcount across 46 countries. Direct operational capacity (CRO = 100% labor business). FY25: 6,200 (+300 net) after FY23-24 plateau (biotech funding winter).

kpis.description_fr: Résultat opérationnel Medpace. Marge op FY25 = 21,1% (534,9 / 2530,2), niveau élevé pour CRO. Discipline opérationnelle modèle owner-operated (Troendle CEO/fondateur 19% capital).
kpis.description_en: Medpace operating income. FY25 op margin = 21.1% ($534.9M / $2,530.2M), high level for CRO sector. Owner-operated model discipline (Troendle CEO/founder owns 19%).

kpis.description_fr: Résultat net Medpace FY25 : 451,1 M $ (+11,6%). Programme rachat actions actif : 2,96 M actions rachetées pour 912,9 M $ en 2025 (vs 174,2 M $ en 2024). Pas de dividende, full reinvestment + buybacks.
kpis.description_en: Medpace net income FY25: $451.1M (+11.6%). Active share repurchase program: 2.96M shares for $912.9M in 2025 (vs $174.2M in 2024). No dividend, full reinvestment + buybacks.

kpis_story.description_fr: Marché biotech funding 2024 (XBI -10%) impacte directement Medpace (clientèle 80% biotech vs 20% big pharma). Signaux reprise 2026 : Fed cuts, M&A pharma, IPO biotech reprend. Net new business inflection attendu.
kpis_story.description_en: 2024 biotech funding market (XBI -10%) directly impacts Medpace (80% biotech vs 20% big pharma clientele). 2026 recovery signals: Fed cuts, pharma M&A, biotech IPO recovery. Net new business inflection expected.

_notes: Mid-cap biotech CRO specialist. Source: 10-K FY25 filed Feb 2026. Backlog updated $1.89Bn per 10-K. Added Cash KPI to reach 5.
